invalidations.reason: The public policy requires a bounded no-later-than retry deadline and requires generation, digest, and completion facts to bind the same confirmation occurrence. The final DecisionPackage schema cannot encode a retry deadline or an occurrence-group binding, while the evaluator accepts an in-window notBefore value and independently satisfiable fact conditions. It can therefore accept plans that retry after the deadline or combine facts from different observations.
